tools.name: describe_texas_wellbores
tools.description: Free, no API key required. Describes the Texas Railroad Commission wellbore identity dataset decoded from RRC's EBCDIC mainframe corpus: the exact fields available, row count, freshness, pricing, and which parts of the source are NOT yet parsed. Returns no records. Call this before search_texas_well

tools.name: search_texas_wellbores
tools.description: Search Texas oil and gas wellbore identities by district, county, API number, plugged status, orphan-well hold, completion date range or minimum depth. FREE tier: up to 25 real decoded rows per call with no API key, so you can judge the data before paying. Asking for more than 25 rows or using offse
